flawed_step: Step 1: Establish that every tournament on four vertices contains a directed cycle. This cannot be justified.
counterexample: Let the vertices be 1,2,3,4 and orient every edge i→j whenever i<j. This is a tournament, but labels strictly increase along every directed path, so it has no directed cycle and therefore no Hamiltonian cycle.
assessment_summary: The statement is false: the transitive tournament on four vertices is a counterexample.
